description: `ParseTopic` / `parse_topic`: validate with the construction-time validator, then split the Object segment on its FIRST underscore into `object` and `modifier`. On success `source`, `category`, `object`, `modifier` and `action` are the parsed parts, and `rerender` is what the returned builder renders for that action; `rerender_error` is the panic text instead, for the one shape that does not round-trip (empty object and modifier). On failure `error` is the exact invalid-topic message (`bus: invalid topic: "<topic>" (<validator message>)`), except the not-past-tense case, which uses `error_contains` (see README).

cases.name: multi-underscore modifier splits on first underscore
object is a lone underscore
cases.rerender_error: bus.TopicOf: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config..failed" (topic "kit.config..failed" has empty segment at position 2)

cases.name: empty
cases.error: bus: invalid topic: "" (topic is empty (expected source.category.object.action))

cases.name: three segments
cases.error: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.snapshot" (topic "kit.config.snapshot" has 3 segments; expected 4 (source.category.object.action))

cases.name: five segments
cases.error: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.snapshot.reload.x" (topic "kit.config.snapshot.reload.x" has 5 segments; expected 4 (source.category.object.action))

cases.name: uppercase source
cases.error: bus: invalid topic: "Kit.config.snapshot.reloaded" (topic "Kit.config.snapshot.reloaded" segment "Kit" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores)

cases.name: present-tense action
error_contains: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.snapshot.create" (topic "kit.config.snapshot.create" action segment "create" is not past-tense (e.g. "started", "created")

cases.name: punctuation in action
cases.error: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.snapshot.re-loaded" (topic "kit.config.snapshot.re-loaded" segment "re-loaded" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores)

cases.name: empty segment
cases.error: bus: invalid topic: "kit..snapshot.reloaded" (topic "kit..snapshot.reloaded" has empty segment at position 1)

cases.name: wildcard
cases.error: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.*.reloaded" (topic "kit.config.*.reloaded" segment "*" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores)

cases.name: trailing dot
cases.error: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.snapshot.reloaded." (topic "kit.config.snapshot.reloaded." has 5 segments; expected 4 (source.category.object.action))
